description: This course introduces students to the operation and design of microprocessors and computer hardware, as well as how software interacts with hardware at a low level. Topics include an overview of digital design, CPU microarchitecture, performance enhancement techniques such as pipelining and parallel processing, and memory and I/O systems. The course places a strong emphasis on hands-on experience, with students working in small groups to implement a pipelined processor on an FPGA.
